definitions.explanation: To officially accept applications, requests, or submissions; to handle reception of documents or visitors.
To be able to stomach or tolerate something; often used in negative form to indicate incompatibility.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みは{来週|らいしゅう}まで{受|う}け{付|つ}けています。
examples.english: We are accepting applications until next week.

examples.japanese: {苦情|くじょう}は{受|う}け{付|つ}けません。
{予約|よやく}は{電話|でんわ}でも{受|う}け{付|つ}けています。
examples.english: We also accept reservations by phone.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}で{書類|しょるい}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けてもらった。
examples.english: I had my documents accepted at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {相談|そうだん}は{月曜日|げつようび}から{金曜日|きんようび}まで{受|う}け{付|つ}けています。
examples.english: We accept consultations from Monday to Friday.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}がアルコールを{受|う}け{付|つ}けない。
{朝|あさ}から{何|なに}も{食|た}べられない。{体|からだ}が{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けないんだ。
examples.english: I haven't been able to eat anything since morning. My body won't accept food.

examples.japanese: あの{薬|くすり}は{苦|にが}くて{受|う}け{付|つ}けなかった。
examples.english: That medicine was so bitter I couldn't stomach it.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{考|かんが}え{方|かた}はどうしても{受|う}け{付|つ}けない。
examples.english: I just can't accept his way of thinking.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}しすぎて、{胃|い}が{何|なに}も{受|う}け{付|つ}けなかった。
examples.english: I was so nervous that my stomach wouldn't accept anything.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{受|う}ける (to receive) + {付|つ}ける (to attach, to apply)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約|よやく}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept reservations
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}みを{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept applications
- {相談|そうだん}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept consultations
- {体|からだ}が{受|う}け{付|つ}けない: body can't tolerate

RELATED NOUN:
- {受付|うけつけ}: reception desk, receptionist
